1.consolidated_definition: mús. cin. Técnica dedicada a componer conjuntos de piezas musicales para acompañar una película. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. A través de su envolvimiento con su empresa, Luis se desenvuelve en el área de advertising produciendo, componiendo, ingeniería de sonido y arreglando jingles para radio y television al igual videos y film scoring
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Musical composition. Cinematographic technique dedicated to composing sets of musical pieces to accompany a film. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used.

Through his involvement with the company, Luis excels in the area of advertising by producing, composing, sound engineering, and arranging jingles for radio and television as well as videos and film scoring.
